Implemented both requested improvements:

- Pasting a URL now simulates metadata discovery and fills the title, description, and suggested tags automatically.
- Every bookmark now has an Edit action for changing its URL, title, description, collection, and tags.
- Changes persist after reloading.

I verified the complete add → enrich → edit → reload flow with browser automation. Review the update at [http://maker:4000](http://maker:4000).
